purpose: Validation criteria a BigANN1M data manifest MUST satisfy before any Gate 5B 1M execution. These are criteria, NOT a manifest: a real manifest must be generated from the real file by scripts/make_data_manifest.py and validated.

required_facts.bvecs_record_layout: per record: uint32 LE dimension prefix (==128), then 128 uint8

provenance_requirements: Source must be the BigANN base (e.g. bigann_base.bvecs from the ANN-benchmarks / SIFT1B distribution), first 1,000,000 records.
Record a SHA-256 of the exact source file and of each derived fbin/bvecs.
bvecs<->fbin coordinate conversion must be cross-checked by oracle/independent_check.py (all coordinates equal) before use.
Do not derive the 1M set by duplicating/upscaling the 100K subset; that is a substitute experiment and is out of scope.

cluster_num.reason: Keep 1000 for comparability; revisit only if cache/chunk sizing demands it, and document. NOT changed in this round (no 1M run).

mem_budget.reason: Cache budget is defined as 10% of the joined data bytes, so it scales with n*d*4. Report configured budget, actual allocation, other working memory and process peak RSS separately; never equate cache %% with total-memory %%.

threshold_squared.reason: Fixed by protocol. Not re-searched at any scale.

gt_config_field.note: DiskJoin.h samples ids divisible by 100000 for its in-binary 'sampled recall' print. At n=1,000,000 that selects 10 seed ids, not just id 0. This in-binary number is NOT the reported metric; the protocol reports externally-computed full-neighborhood GT over the fixed 200 evaluation endpoints via oracle/evaluate.py. Must be stated explicitly at 1M.

Using it would be fabricating/truncating a substitute dataset.
